info.name: Crafting Service
info.description:
Test collection for the Crafting Service (`services/crafting-service`).

Crafting runs as several replicas behind the Gateway. Every request goes to the Gateway (`baseUrl`, `http://localhost:8000`), which reads the Crafting instances from the Discovery Service and sends each request to the next one in turn (Round-Robin). Crafting calls Resource, Player and Exam Service through the Gateway too, so the whole stack has to be running (`docker compose up -d` in the CPR).

Run the folders top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). **Discovery** checks the Crafting instances are registered; **Setup** registers a player and gives it wood and metal; **Recipes** to **Not Found Cases** cover the recipe CRUD; **Crafting** crafts an item, retries it with the same idempotency key and checks the locked, unaffordable, invalid and unknown cases; **Cleanup** deletes everything the run created.

To see the balancing, follow `docker logs -f cpr-gateway` while sending requests: every line names the instance a request went to.

Variables: `baseUrl` is the Gateway (`http://localhost:8000`); `discoveryUrl` is the Discovery Service (`http://localhost:8500`). Crafting no longer publishes a port of its own.
